company_name: Country Garden Services Holdings Company Limited

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: average of base-case years 1-5, anchored on H1 FY2026 revenue +5.7%, FY2025 +9.9%, revenue-bearing GFA +3.2% in FY2025, and the shrinking developing-business segments
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (19.8%) and revenue 5yr CAGR (25.4%) are acquisition- and placement-inflated (FY2020-21 M&A spree, Lanting/Manguo/Fullshare etc.) and diverge >30% from EPS (-28.7%) and owner FCF (-12.9%); the 3yr figures (equity -1.4%, revenue +5.3%, EPS -32.2%) describe the current business. Neither the 5yr equity CAGR nor the EPS CAGR is a usable forward rate; the base uses 4-5% decelerating.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF CAGRs (-13.6% 3yr, -12.9% 5yr) are below reported-FCF CAGRs (-8.0%, -10.4%): SBC fell FY2020->FY2025 (233.7 -> 183.1) but interest income rose (158.4 -> 265.5) as the cash pile grew, so a rising share of reported FCF is deposit interest, not operations. Owner-FCF series: FY2020 2,876.0; FY2022 2,227.5; FY2025 1,438.1.

scenario_narratives.base: Stable recurring property-management core (~70% of revenue, 90% of growth) grows mid-single digits as third-party GFA replaces the flat CGH pipeline; margins settle near 8.2-8.4% after a last leg of developing-business erosion; the recurring 'non-core' credit items are treated as a cost of doing business; RMB1.5bn dividends plus buybacks are covered by ~RMB1.9bn owner FCF without touching the cash pile. Discounted at 15% (10.5% base plus 4.5% of structural premia for the CGH counterparty and governance single point of failure).
scenario_narratives.bull: Bifu IFM and third-party wins keep growth at 6-7%, PARA technology delivers the labour productivity management promises, gross margin stops falling, receivable collections normalise and the cash-tax drag unwinds; the market re-rates part-way toward SOE-backed peers. Same 15% rate: a good operating year does not dissolve the shareholder structure.
scenario_narratives.bear: The parent overhang bites operationally rather than just reputationally: CGH-estate attrition, non-renewal of low-margin contracts, and a further round of receivable write-offs shrink revenue and halve the owner-FCF margin; governance (dual chairmanship, related-party loans funded from the cash pile) keeps the multiple pinned near net cash.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Market capitalisation at the current price is roughly equal to net cash (about RMB4.1 per share, HK$4.9), so the market is paying ~nothing for operations that generated RMB2.5bn of core profit and ~RMB1.4-1.9bn of owner FCF in a bad year and that fund RMB1.5bn/yr of dividends plus ~RMB0.4bn of cancelled buybacks (~12% of market cap returned annually). The model values the operations on a normalised 8.2-8.4% EBITDA margin that already carries ~RMB1.6bn/yr of receivable impairments as a recurring cost, holds the share count flat with SBC expensed, strips finance income and counts the cash once in the bridge. WACC: the discount rate is 15.0% in every scenario, built as a 10.5% base cost of equity (1.8% CGB + 1.25 x 7.0% ERP) plus two explicit structural premia under the Step 8c.5 structural-WACC-understatement fix: +2.5% for single-counterparty concentration (49% of GFA and ~RMB2.0bn of receivables from the distressed, related Country Garden Holdings) and +2.0% for the regulatory/structural single point of failure (dual chairmanship, Feb-2026 SSE sanction, RMB1.0bn related-party loan from the cash pile, RMB907m of judicially frozen deposits). The premia were added on 2026-10-24 after the multiples sanity check tripped: at 10.5% the weighted IV of HK$13.40 implied 112.9x FY2025 SBC-adjusted EPS against a 10yr average of 47.0x (ceiling 94x). MULTIPLES VS HISTORY: the implied P/E is high in part because the denominator is FY2025 statutory EPS depressed by a RMB969m goodwill impairment and RMB1,088m of acquired-intangible amortisation (statutory profit ~RMB0.5bn against core profit ~RMB2.5bn); on core earnings the weighted IV is roughly 11-15x, inside the 10yr P/E range (11.8x-84.6x) and far below the 47x average that was set in the FY2018-22 growth-premium era. Implied P/B (~1.3x) and P/S (~1.0x) sit well below their 10yr averages (6.7x, 4.8x), which is the bear-market-sector reality rather than a model artefact. Even the bear case lands above the price because net cash alone covers it; the thesis therefore rests less on growth than on whether the cash is, and stays, shareholders' money. The dividend and cancel-on-repurchase record says it is; the related-party loan says watch it. The 15% rate equals the 15% hurdle, so the base entry price and base intrinsic value coincide: at today's price the model is saying a 15% required return is cleared with a margin, provided the cash is real.

wacc_premium.trigger: sanity_check 2026-10-23: implied P/E 112.9x vs 10yr average 47.0x (2x ceiling 94x); diagnosis wacc_too_low / regulatory single point of failure
wacc_premium.overlap_note: The bear scenario's 30% weight and its flows also price CGH-contagion outcomes; the rate premium and the weights deliberately overlap under the fix playbook.

key_risks_to_valuation: Cash leakage to the controlling shareholder's other entities: a repeat of the RMB1.0bn FY2025 related-party loan, or dividends increasingly settled by offset against such loans, would convert bridge cash into impaired receivables; the model credits none of the existing loan but all of the deposits

CGH-estate attrition and receivable write-offs beyond the bear path: ~49% of revenue-bearing GFA and ~RMB2.0bn of receivables are CGH-linked; the bear case assumes ~12% cumulative revenue decline and ~RMB4bn of further write-offs, not a wholesale loss of the CGH book
Margin erosion continuing past 8.2%: gross margin fell 19.1% -> 17.5% -> 18.1% (H1) and the developing business (31% of revenue) keeps losing margin; the base assumes the slide stops in FY2026

Restricted or trapped cash: 907m of frozen/performance deposits is already excluded, but a further portion of the 15.3bn could be judicially frozen if CGH litigation spills over, or pledged beyond the 2.2bn already backing FX forwards

Recurring 'non-recurring' items: goodwill impairments (969m FY2025, 990m FY2024) are excluded as non-cash sunk M&A cost, but guarantee losses, equity-pledged-loan impairments and the 'material arbitration' keep appearing; the base absorbs ~0.5pp of margin for them, which may not be enough

Terminal value: at a 15% WACC the Gordon multiple (7.8x base) governs rather than the 12x cap; the sector has traded at 5-8x core earnings for three years, so the terminal assumes little re-rating from today, but a 15% rate applied to a cash annuity is harsh if the governance discount ever lifts (base IV at 10.5% was HK$14.09)

Implied multiple optics: the implied P/E against FY2025 SBC-adjusted statutory EPS stays elevated (impairment- and amortisation-depressed denominator) even after the WACC premium; a reader comparing to the 47x 10yr average should use core EPS, on which the valuation is ~11-15x

inputs.share_count_basis: 3,258,334,489 shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim) plus 67,487,030 scrip-dividend shares issued 21 August 2026 = 3,325.8m. Options under the 2024 Share Option Scheme have nil dilutive effect per the interim EPS note; the Share Award Scheme is funded by on-market purchases already inside the count. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). The scrip is genuine non-SBC issuance but is a one-off already in the count; future scrip take-up is assumed offset by the ongoing cancel-on-repurchase programme.
inputs.cash_composition: 30 June 2026: cash and cash equivalents 8,235.1 + time deposits 5,887.8 (incl. 2,200.9 pledged for FX forwards, released on maturity) + structured deposits 1,151.8 = 15,274.7. EXCLUDED: restricted bank deposits 907.4 (judicially frozen funds and performance-security deposits), the RMB1.0bn loan to related parties owned by the controlling shareholder (RMB252.4m offset against the Aug-2026 dividend; remainder not credited), FVOCI equity investments (their ~RMB35-42m/yr dividends are left inside other income instead).
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 finance income (deposit interest) RMB265.5m. Interest received sits in INVESTING on this filer's cash-flow statement, so reported FCF (OCF - capex) never contained it; the house formula strips it anyway, making last_fcf a conservative anchor. The forward component build starts from operating profit, which excludes finance income by construction, so the cash pile is counted once, in the bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report, non-HKFRS reconciliation 'share-based payment expenses' RMB183.1m (equals the cash-flow add-back). EquityAwardTaxes nil in every year (awards settled from on-market purchases, no net-share settlement). H1 FY2026: RMB59.5m.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow 'Purchase shares for the share award scheme/buy-back of shares' RMB378.1m (FY2024: 545.4m; H1 FY2026: 185.7m). Repurchased shares are cancelled, so the flat count is being funded, not assumed.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1748 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X on 2026-10-23. No dual listing for a parity check; cross-check: the FY2025 final/special dividend was declared at RMB4.62c = HKD5.32c (1.152, March-2026 rate), consistent in direction and within the year's RMB appreciation. All per-share values are computed in RMB and multiplied by fx_rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD so they compare to current_price.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in the flows' currency (CNY) as a BASE rate plus two explicit STRUCTURAL PREMIA (Step 8c.5 structural-WACC-understatement fix, applied 2026-10-24 after the multiples sanity check tripped on implied P/E 112.9x vs a 47.0x 10yr average). BASE 10.5%: 10y China government bond ~1.8% + beta 1.25 x China/HK equity risk premium 7.0% = ~10.5% cost of equity; borrowings are <10% of EV so WACC = cost of equity. PREMIUM 1, single-counterparty concentration +2.5% (top of the +1.5-2.5% band): 49% of revenue-bearing GFA and ~RMB2.0bn of receivables derive from one related party, Country Garden Holdings and its JVs, which is itself in default and restructuring, so the concentration is in a distressed counterparty rather than merely a large one, and homeowner-committee switching on CGH estates is a correlated, not idiosyncratic, revenue risk. PREMIUM 2, regulatory/structural single point of failure +2.0% (top of the +1.0-2.0% band): the controlling shareholder chairs both companies; the Shanghai Stock Exchange sanctioned her in Feb-2026; a RMB1.0bn loan to her other entities was made from the cash pile in FY2025 and is being partly settled by offset against dividends; RMB907m of deposits are judicially frozen. These are realised governance events, not hypotheticals, so the premium sits at the top of its range. TOTAL 15.0%, applied identically in bear, base and bull. Acknowledged overlap: the bear scenario's flows and its 30% weight ALSO carry CGH-contagion outcomes (receivable write-offs, GFA attrition), so the counterparty risk is now charged in both the rate and the weights; that is deliberate under the fix playbook because the market-implied multiple history says a standard rate under-prices this name's structure. The 15.0% WACC coincides with the 15% hurdle rate, so entry_price.base equals valuation.base. At 15% the Gordon terminal multiple is 1.02/0.13 = 7.8x, below the 12x cap, so the cap no longer binds in the base case.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease cash (FY2025 principal 154.4 + interest on leases 76.1 = 230.5, 0.48% of revenue) deducted inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (1,228.3 at 30 June 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt; D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 total D&A 1,998.6 - acquired-intangible amortisation 1,088.4 - ROU depreciation 159.3 = 750.9, 1.55%).
inputs.nci_treatment: Leakage folded into the cash-tax path (option c, charged once): FY2025 core tax 866.4 + core NCI share 84.3 = 950.7 on core operating profit 3,380.4 = 28.1%. NCI book (2,358.6 at 30 June 2026) is NOT deducted in the bridge; most of it sits in loss-making or impaired subsidiaries (Manguo) whose statutory NCI share was -2.6 in FY2025, so book materially overstates the economic claim.
inputs.normalisation: EBITDA is pre-SBC, IFRS-16 basis, built from core operating profit: statutory OP 1,029.3 + goodwill impairment 968.9 + SBC 183.1 + acquired-intangible amortisation 1,088.4 + impairment of equity-pledged loans 256.4 + disposal losses 91.6 + external-guarantee losses 83.3 - related-party receivable reversals 313.1 - contingent-consideration gain 7.5 = 3,380.4 (ties to core PBT 3,469.7 less net finance income 139.0 plus associate losses 49.7). Plus D&A ex acquired intangibles 910.2 = 4,290.6 = 8.87% of FY2025 revenue (FY2024 11.6%; H1 FY2026 10.6% against a seasonally weak H2 of ~6.5%). Ordinary receivable ECL (~RMB1.6bn, 3.3% of revenue) is left INSIDE core as a recurring cost of this business. The 'non-recurring' guarantee and equity-pledged-loan losses have recurred three periods running and the offsetting related-party reversals are fading (H1 FY2026 net cost 0.8% of half-year revenue), so the base margin steps down ~0.7pp from the FY2025 core figure rather than carrying it forward.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing: operating company, non-US, with leases, NCI and a reporting/quote currency split, so owner-fcf.md plus the adaptations file). First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry. Y1 = FY2026 against a 30 June 2026 balance sheet: H1 FY2026 operating cash flow was seasonally negative (-749), so overlapping half-year flows are conservative, not flattering. The FY2025 RMB405m investment-property purchase is excluded from the capex path as non-recurring (nil in FY2024 and H1 FY2026). Price is the HKEX regular close, not an after-hours print. Cash tax paid (1,226 in FY2025) exceeds core P&L tax (866) because ECL provisions are not deductible until written off; the base cash-tax+NCI path therefore starts at 31% and eases to 29% as write-offs catch up with provisions. 2026-10-24 sanity-check fix pass: WACC raised 10.5% -> 15.0% in all scenarios via two explicit structural premia (see wacc_rationale); no driver path, weight, terminal growth or cap was changed.

bear.wacc_note: Same 15.0% as base. The bear flows additionally carry the realised form of the counterparty risk (write-offs, GFA attrition), so this scenario charges it twice by design.
bear.narrative: CGH-contagion path: homeowner committees on CGH-developed estates (49% of GFA) switch managers at rising rates, developing-business contracts are not renewed, and revenue shrinks ~12% cumulatively over FY2027-30. A further ~20% of the RMB21.5bn receivable book proves uncollectable over five years (~RMB0.8bn/yr), taking normalised EBITDA to 5.5%; ECL stays non-deductible so cash tax + NCI leakage sits at 33%. No working-capital release on shrinkage (the receivables that would 'unwind' are the ones that are not paid). Terminal 1.0%, 10x cap. Net cash is NOT haircut in this scenario: it is being distributed (RMB1.5bn dividend floor plus ~RMB0.4bn buybacks a year), which is the evidence it belongs to shareholders.

base.wacc_note: 10.5% base cost of equity + 2.5% single-counterparty concentration premium + 2.0% structural single-point-of-failure premium; see inputs.wacc_rationale.
base.narrative: Revenue +5% in FY2026 (H1 +5.7%, H2 weaker as developing business shrinks) decelerating to 2% as third-party GFA wins offset flat CGH handovers. Normalised EBITDA margin steps down to 8.2% from 8.87% core (gross margin erosion of ~0.4pp/yr in the developing business, recurring guarantee/equity-pledged-loan losses no longer offset by related-party reversals), then recovers 20bp by year 5 as PARA robotics/AI trims the RMB18bn labour line. Working capital consumes 12% of incremental revenue (160-day receivables), as in FY2024 and FY2025. Cash tax + NCI leakage 31% easing to 29%. Terminal 2.0% in RMB (sub-GDP, low-inflation China); the 12x cap is retained as a ceiling but at a 15% WACC the Gordon multiple is 1.02/0.13 = 7.8x, so Gordon governs.

bull.wacc_note: Same 15.0% as base: the structural premia are a property of the shareholder structure, not of the operating scenario, so the bull case does not get a lower rate.
bull.narrative: Third-party and IFM (Bifu) wins sustain 6-7% growth; newly contracted annualised revenue (+86% FY2025, +53% H1 FY2026) converts to GFA. Gross margin stabilises as the developing business is pruned and PARA robots scale past pilots, lifting normalised EBITDA to 10% (still below FY2024's 11.6%). Receivable write-offs catch up with provisions so cash tax normalises toward 27%, collections improve (WC capture -10%). Terminal 2.5%, 14x cap (a re-rating toward SOE-backed peers, not to them); at 15% WACC Gordon is 1.025/0.125 = 8.2x so the cap is not reached.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: a single related counterparty (CGH and its JVs) still underlies 49% of managed GFA and ~RMB2.0bn of receivables, the controlling shareholder chairs both companies and was sanctioned by the Shanghai Stock Exchange in Feb-2026, and the RMB1.0bn related-party loan shows the cash pile can be lent out as well as paid out. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent things to go right (PARA payoff, gross-margin stabilisation, collections, and a re-rating). Base 50%. Weights were left UNCHANGED in the 2026-10-24 WACC fix pass: the fix playbook addresses the rate, and lowering the bear weight to compensate would undo the fix; the resulting overlap between rate and weights is stated in wacc_rationale.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
